decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Plant Noise Assessment, Planning and Design and Access Statement, PP1, GA-EXTG-01, GA-EXTG-02, GA-PROP-01 Rev. A, GA-PROP-02 Rev. A Received: 07 March 2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The level of noise emitted from any external plant shall not exceed 10dB below background noise level as measured from the nearest sensitive noise location in accordance with BS4142:1997

Condition : 4 - Any external plant shall not operate outside the hours of 09:00 - 17:30 Monday - Saturday and 11:00 - 16:00 on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the operation of the air conditioning units, neoprene mounts as specified in the Plant Noise Assessment Report shall be installed, maintained, repaired and replaced as specified in the Plant Noise Assessment Report

Condition : 6 - Prior to the installation of the air conditioning units details of the proposed acoustic enclosure shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any acoustic enclosure shall be maintained, repaired and replaced.
description: Replacement of 1 no. air conditioning unit with 2 no. air conditioning units to rear of shop
